correctness.rationale: Recomputed indicator overlaps: for edge e=xy, two endpoint vertices contribute −2pq^(3d−2); 2(d−1−c_e) adjacent non-endpoint vertices contribute p²q^(3d−3) each; c_e common neighbors contribute pq^(3d−4)(1−q²), and all remaining vertices contribute zero. Summing c_e=3t yields the exact identity. After dividing by nd p q^(3d−4) for 0<p<1, F(p)=−1+(d+1)p−(d−τ)p² with 0<=τ=3t/(nd)<d. Smaller root is 2/(d+1+sqrt((d−1)^2+4τ)), and F(1)=τ gives sign; endpoints p=0,1 vanish directly. d-cases d>=2 handled, Q_d triangle-free n=2^d; λ/d limit follows standard exponential limit. Independent rational enumeration on C4,K4,triangular-prism across p=1/5,1/3,4/5 matched all 9 exact strata. Finite test is not proof of universal statement.
